application_review: Exact finite-set event sums and positive coefficient lower bounds prove the actual conditioning denominator is positive. Lower and upper coefficient bounds give pointwise domination of the original conditional mass by a finite uniform law, and pointwise domination transfers to every event.

The original raw harmonic weights on any nonempty finite subset of a dyadic interval inside the rough cutoff lie between b and 2*b for an explicit positive b. Their actual conditional law is consequently at most twice uniform. Complete dyadic residue bins are identified as such subsets using cutoff containment, roughness-modulus divisibility and unit residues.

The exposed tail law is defined as the product of the original coordinate conditional masses and proved equal to conditioning the original product law on all coordinate bins. Its nonnegativity, normalization, support membership, pointwise and event domination by 2^card(iota) times the product uniform law are proved. The actual tail product lies between the product of lower endpoints and 2^card(iota) times that product.

For the actual tail product, two explicit endpoint inequalities imply that every pivot short-bin preimage is fully inside the original cutoff. The original short-bin and pivot-residue posterior is at most 3*2^card(iota) times the product uniform law on the exposed dyadic sets, specialized explicitly to the full prescribed dyadic residue bins. No exact pivot microcell is conditioned upon.

Reviewed normalization rather than assuming bounded densities: the event mass equals the sum of original coefficients on the finite set, has a positive cardinality-times-lower-bound estimate, and supplies the exact denominator in the pointwise conditional bound.

Reviewed dyadic comparison: only the original inverse-natural weights and common original normalizer are used. Each selected point lies between A and 2*A; no assertion of uniformity of unconditioned harmonic sampling or prime sampling is introduced.

Reviewed dependence: equality with conditioning the original independent product law is obtained from exact product event and conditioning identities. Independence after coordinate-bin conditioning is proved, not taken as a fresh assumption. Short-bin conditioning is subsequently allowed to couple the coordinates.

Reviewed actual scale and endpoints: the tail product is the product of the sampled natural values, and its support bounds imply full pivot cutoff containment from two explicit inequalities. The theorem does not assert that these inequalities hold with high probability until discarded-bin estimates and parameter growth are connected.

Reviewed scope: the full dyadic-residue specialization requires nonempty bins fully inside their cutoffs. Arbitrary subsets inside dyadic intervals are also covered, but identifying clipped bins with the later permitted boxes remains work. Exact microcell conditioning and global face invariance are not claimed.
All named declarations are strictly elaborated and checked for transitive axioms. Prior sources and prior axiom sets remain unchanged. No independent kernel replay or full-target proof is claimed.

StrongConjecture and the original full finite monochromatic sums/products claim remain unproved. Finite-list native periodic interval inverse existence remains an explicit unproved hypothesis; its genuine existence proof and positive uniform correlation constants must be supplied. Conditional Prediction includes actual admissible parameters, positive finite scale-list closure, common native unit observables and complete fixed-ultrafilter calibration and count limits. Conditional Alignment includes the canonical finite-word schedule, actual execution, positive palette-scale budgets, common positive denominator and certified actual auxiliary visits. Integer realization now proves the actual master pair scale relation, exact natural numerator with its original rational value, canonical bounded full-modulus residues, all required divisibilities, uniform eventual fixed-integer divisibility, finite numerical slot bounds and the numerical own-target array-letter identity. The actual earlier-variable exposure fixes every residue and slot shift, full own-target numerators and array residues; exact affine tail dependence of each progression and the whole own-target progression sum is proved. Concrete integer-input polynomial array groups, their common nilpotence bound, input translations, pointwise lattice coset evaluation and exact affine model linear orbits are constructed. The genuine original native Lie polynomial-array coefficient algebra, bracket closure, high-degree cutoff and finite dimension are now proved; literal Lie evaluation homomorphisms and their lower-central compatibility are constructed. The same-step lower-central cutoff of the genuine array Lie algebra, injectivity of all integer evaluations and simultaneous coefficient recovery by one fixed finite integer evaluation set are now proved, including for the original native model. The actual binary product native Lie algebra, componentwise original exponential and global logarithm, and integration and inherited topology of every product Lie subalgebra are now proved. The complete native array coefficient algebra now embeds by one fixed finite family of integer inputs into the native Lie algebra of an actual finite original-group product. Its finite evaluation image integrates to a closed contractible simply connected subgroup, uniquely parameterized by coefficient exponentials. All-integer multiplication compatibility, the exact full exponential array subgroup, its group isomorphism and inherited-topology homeomorphism with the finite image, contractibility, simply connectedness, and discreteness of its pointwise Gamma-valued subgroup for discrete Gamma are now proved. Cocompactness of the exact all-integer pointwise lattice is now proved by actual lattice monomial spanning, rational-log intersection, positive-root character descent and continuous quotient transfer. The actual integrated subalgebra and full native array group now have constructed smooth manifold and Lie group structures on their inherited topologies, and all literal integer evaluations are smooth. The actual array group and exact lattice instantiate the existing NativeNilmanifoldData interface at the same original nilpotency step, with constructed compatible quotient metric. Integer input translations now preserve the actual graded coefficient Lie algebra, the full native exponential array group and its exact all-integer lattice; actual group and coset homeomorphisms and continuous coset evaluation with exact translation compatibility are proved. Array input translations are now proved smooth with smooth inverses in the existing original exponential charts. Original affine power-times-basepoint model arrays are proved to belong to the actual native array group; their exact evaluations, input translations and linear time orbit are proved both in the group and in its exact lattice coset space. Actual original and array discrete-lattice quotient manifolds are now constructed on the retained coset topologies; original quotient projections, all integer-input quotient evaluations and original quotient translations are smooth, with the latter having proved smooth inverses. The dependent product joint group, its exact product lattice, compact coset space, common nilpotency cutoff, original joint model orbit, component evaluations and input shifts are now constructed with exact formulas. The finite joint group now has its constructed finite-dimensional complete Lie model, global product exponential diffeomorphism and original smooth group operations, and instantiates NativeNilmanifoldData with the exact joint group, exact lattice and same common step. The original joint quotient is a smooth manifold with smooth component integer evaluations and smooth input-shift diffeomorphisms. Uniform quantitative smooth-observable bounds and model-reading calibration remain unproved. The finite short-bin pivot likelihood estimate and factor-three posterior domination relative to the original tail prior are now proved for the actual raw harmonic pivot law, with explicit full-cutoff containment, positive normalizer, unit residue and small-discretization hypotheses. The original dyadic-conditioned tail law is now proved equal to conditioning the original product law, and is dominated by 2^card(T) times product uniform. The actual short-bin posterior is now dominated by 3*2^card(T) times product uniform on prescribed dyadic residue bins, with explicit endpoint inequalities ensuring every pivot preimage lies in the cutoff. The complete earlier-variable exposure disintegration, treatment of cutoff-clipped dyadic bins, vanishing probability of discarded pivot-cutoff and H-boundary bins, and eventual satisfaction of these scale inequalities remain to be connected. HasAlignmentMonomialRecurrence remains an explicit unproved input. Its genuine nilpotent recurrence proof, the connection of the constructed joint model to all prescribed quantitative readings, microcell boundary and point-law estimates, and positive-probability Alignment bounds remain unproved. Final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction is incomplete. No unavoidable blocker is established. A complete public proof repository, official contribution PR, independent review and prize application remain pending; no completed prize submission is claimed.
